mos_variance_4.literatureTask: Session MOS and opinion dispersion for one 360° video tiling configuration (ITU-T P.800-style aggregation over encrypted ACR scores).

mos_variance_8.literatureTask: Checkerboard tiling QoE panel: encrypted mean/variance detect low MOS and rating disagreement without revealing individual viewers.

poor_rating_sla_8.literatureTask: Poor-experience SLA monitor: count encrypted ACR scores at or below 'fair' (≤2) for low-quality uniform tiling.
